mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campus) AS campuses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dormitory_building) AS buildings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room) AS rooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed WHERE operational_status = 'ENABLED') AS validBeds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_assignment WHERE assignment_status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeResidents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_assignment WHERE assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND bed_id IS NOT NULL) AS occupiedBeds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bed b WHERE b.room_id = r.id AND b.operational_status != 'RETIRED')) AS roomsWithoutBeds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE r.operational_status = 'ENABLED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bed b WHERE b.room_id = r.id AND b.operational_status = 'ENABLED')) AS enabledRoomsWithoutBeds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE r.capacity != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed b WHERE b.room_id = r.id AND b.operational_status != 'RETIRED')) AS capacityMismatchRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dormitory_floor f LEFT JOIN dormitory_building db ON db.id = f.building_id WHERE db.id IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id WHERE f.id IS NULL) AS invalidRelations

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.account_status, 'PENDING') != 'DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabledStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(u.account_status, 'PENDING') != 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unactivatedStudents, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.student_number IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_number) = '' OR s.student_name IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_name) = '' OR s.grade_year IS NULL OR s.major_id IS NULL OR m.id IS NULL OR m.enabled = 0 OR s.degree_level IS NULL OR s.degree_level NOT IN ('专科','本科','硕士','博士','本硕连读','本博连读') OR s.gender IS NULL OR s.gender NOT IN ('M','F') THEN s.id END) AS invalidStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN s.student_number IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_number) = '' OR s.student_name IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_name) = '' OR s.grade_year IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missingCriticalFields, SUM(CASE WHEN s.major_id IS NULL OR m.id IS NULL OR m.enabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missingMajorMapping, SUM(CASE WHEN s.degree_level NOT IN ('专科','本科','硕士','博士','本硕连读','本博连读') OR s.degree_level IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidDegreeLevel, SUM(CASE WHEN s.gender NOT IN ('M','F') OR s.gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidGender FROM student s LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = s.major_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.student_id = s.id

SELECT s.student_number AS studentNumber FROM student s LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = s.major_id WHERE s.student_number IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_number) = '' OR s.student_name IS NULL OR TRIM(s.student_name) = '' OR s.grade_year IS NULL OR s.major_id IS NULL OR m.id IS NULL OR m.enabled = 0 OR s.degree_level IS NULL OR s.degree_level NOT IN ('专科','本科','硕士','博士','本硕连读','本博连读') OR s.gender IS NULL OR s.gender NOT IN ('M','F') ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, batch_name AS batchName, batch_status AS batchStatus, rule_template_id AS ruleTemplateId FROM selection_batch WHERE batch_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'OPEN', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY start_at, id LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batch_student_eligibility WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batch_student_eligibility e WHERE e.batch_id = #{batchId} AND e.eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_assignment ra WHERE ra.batch_id = e.batch_id AND ra.student_id = e.student_id AND ra.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' )
